patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "capgemini", 2026-10-03

profile_text.body:
Capgemini is a public company that describes itself as a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. Its site organizes its work around insights, industries, services, careers, and about us sections, and it says its portfolio evolves to keep pace with client needs. The company also presents itself as a research publisher through the Capgemini Research Institute, which its site says ranked first in the world six consecutive times.

Much of the material on the site concerns corporate social responsibility and partnerships. Capgemini says it leverages partnerships on environmental sustainability, diversity and inclusion, and digital inclusion. It states that at the end of 2023 it announced a partnership with UNICEF and Generation Unlimited as one of the first private partners supporting the Green Rising initiative, aimed at helping youth gain knowledge and skills to address climate change and the biodiversity crisis. It describes itself as a founding member of the United Nation's Race to Zero campaign, a member of the UN Global Compact's Caring for Climate initiative since its inception in 2007, and a signatory of the UN Global Compact's Business Ambition for 1.5oC CEO statement, committing to science-based targets for limiting global temperature rise.

The available record does not list any AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company.
